verdict.rationale: A built-in assistant is a fair axis for a cloud platform, but the evidence never shows an assistant inside the OCI Console or CLI that users can delegate tasks to. The AI items in the pack do not deliver this story. The Select AI Agent Framework is a database feature for building your own agent teams, OCI Generative AI model import is a model-hosting service, and the MCP server serves external agents rather than acting as an in-product assistant.
